name: Miso Shiru!
source:
Two gal pals on a normal cruise vacation are charmed by a mysterious woman that they happen to rescue on a stranded life raft. Which lucky girl will win the lady's hand first?

[From [url=https://melon-kid.itch.io/miso-shiru]itch.io[/url]]
